{"consolidated_memory":"PROBLEM: Message redelivery in worker/queue/consumer.py (background jobs)
SYMPTOM (both occasions): Same message ID handled more than once

OCCASION 1 [2026-06-17]:
- Triggered only for clients pinned to v1 SDK
- Root cause: Error swallowed by a bare except clause
- Repro: Kill worker mid-batch and restart
- Measured outcome: Memory settled at 695 MB instead of climbing past 7 GB
- Fix: Narrowed the exception handler and let the failure propagate
- PR #4534 on branch fix/message-redelivery-1

OCCASION 2 [2026-09-01]:
- Triggered on first request after a cold start
- Root cause: Off-by-one error in a slice bound
- Repro: Kill worker mid-batch and restart
- Measured outcome: Job finished in 72 minutes instead of 5 hours
- Fix: Corrected the slice bound and added a property test around it
- PR #9113 on branch fix/message-redelivery-2

Both incidents occurred in the same area of worker/queue/consumer.py, so engineering context from earlier work in this component carried over to both investigations."}
